_note: DEMO world for the live demo (pnpm testnet:world, docs/DEMO.md 'Demo world'). Every shop and renter here is FICTIONAL: made-up first names, no real people or businesses. On-chain a wallet is only an address; these names live only in this file and the app shows them with a 'demo persona' badge. Wallet addresses per chain are in demo-world-addresses.json, written by the script: 31337 = the rehearse wallets (keys derived from a public seed, local anvil only), 97 = `pnpm testnet:world run` (keys stay in the gitignored .orca/secrets/demo-world/). Amounts follow web/data/listings.json (THB, at its thbPerUsdt).
